name: Shape Survivors
premise: The protagonist has lost their pheromone transmitter, and the hive hunts them for the silence.

what: The face is angular, takes a gradient, and has compound eyes.

The body is head, thorax and abdomen, with six legs. Not all of it has to show: a creature that is all head keeps its thorax and abdomen behind it, small, and its six legs may be three stubs mirrored — but it is all drawn, and the walk and the death fold on it.
Every body carries the lit pheromone organ (`use: ss.lib.organ`), where the hive can see it.
Legs are two links with a knee; feelers are two-link whips that lag down their length. The dark maw is at the front and works on its own joint, with the fang riding it.
Draw the verb first — what this body does to the player — then the body around it. A body that reaches has an arm; a body that hides is a mound with jaws in it.
A shot is not a body: no organ, no death, no radius. It is the shape of the harm it carries, at the size it is thrown.
The player carries the same organ every creature carries, `dead`: no halo, no bloom, a hairline crack across cold grey. That silence is the premise.
The feelers are the feature the title names. Draw them to be picked out.
A weapon icon composes its weapon (`use` the projectile), so the slot shows the thing itself and the weapon is drawn once.
The tile is that weapon's own colour — the part of its art nothing else owns. `evolved` is the tile going gold, not a second drawing.
Hive material with the signal stripped out, unless it is bait.
`meta.radius` is a contract the game divides by; the art may change, the number may not.
A floor tiles on a torus: every part that crosses an edge is emitted again a tile over, so no seam and no grain-free margin survive.
Shade in steps, not gradients, because the bake flattens a gradient. Grain is seeded `repeat`, never noise.
Author a library part large in its own document and compose it in at a fraction, so it can be judged at the size it was drawn.
A state on a library part is the callers' vocabulary: `dead`, `faint`, `venomed` mean what the documents that use them need.

voice.world: A hive that announces itself by scent, and one body that cannot. Everything in the hive is chitin, husk and carapace with a lit pheromone organ on it; the survivor carries the same organ dead, and is hunted for the silence. It is seen four hundred bodies at a time, on soil and on the salt pan under the sun. What the game says, it says with a shape and a glow.
form: Silhouettes carry identity. If two bodies are the same in black, colour is doing work shape should be doing.
Each body is the shape of the one thing it does: a Locust is a hind leg, an Antlion is two jaws standing out of a mound, a Hurler carries its shot on its back.
At game scale you read a shape and a glow, not anatomy — so a head and thorax may fuse, and six legs may be three stubs mirrored — but the anatomy is drawn underneath, and the rig hinges on it.
Concave and asymmetric on purpose — `poly` exists for it. A convex blob in a different hue is the failure this roster was redrawn to escape.
The feature the fiction names is drawn large enough to pick out: the feelers, the organ, the jaws.
material: The hive is chitin, husk and carapace, lit by its signal — pheromone and pink.

The arsenal is hive material with the signal stripped out: chitin, husk bone, molt shell, honed to a cold frost edge, and never magenta. The one weapon that breaks it is bait, and breaks it on purpose.
A weapon icon's rim is that weapon's own colour — the part of its art nothing else owns, not the part there is most of.
Gold means a state (evolved), never a material. Pheromone is the hive's colour, never the player's.
Paint with tokens. A raw hex is a number nobody can read, and a theme cannot restyle it.
light: One light, up-screen. A rim bands off it; inside a tilted hole the rim reverses, because the wall you see into it is the far one.
The Phaser bake flattens a gradient, so anything that must read in the game steps its shading rather than blending it.
A glow is a halo, a bloom and a socket — ghost, soft, full — never one flat disc.
motion: A hinge is not a prop. A leg folds as equal rot down the chain plus the x/y each link's offset sweeps: two links with a knee, feelers as two-link whips that lag down their length.
Animations move parts within a body, never the body. Spin, facing, knockback and hit-flash belong to the engine.
Every death is one grammar in many readings: the seize, the give, the settle. What differs is what each creature is. Arrive by 0.85, then hold.
A loop is judged breathing in the gallery; a one-shot is judged still, frame by frame, on a filmstrip.
scale: Authored at 32 on a 4px grid, seen at 1.35×, on the floor it spawns on. Judge it big for form, at game scale for survival, in black for identity.
A body holds at least 2.5:1 against its floor; below that it sinks. The pan's household is judged on the pan, not the field.
Library parts are authored large in their own document and composed in at a fraction, so a head can be judged at the size it was drawn.
sound: The palette is split the way the fiction is: half the hive's body — tap, shell, bone, grit — and half its voice, the A-minor degrees the score already plays, so an effect cannot clash with the music.
Hit is the smallest sound in the set, because it plays hundreds of times a run. Levels come off a five-rung ladder, not sixteen floats.
A square or sawtooth carries a filter, or says why it does not. Per-trigger variation is jitter the engine rolls; everything else is seeded.
never: Two creatures the same cream, or the same convex blob.
A second drawing of a thing that exists: compose it with `use`; a state is a patch, not a redraw.
A number where a token carries identity.
A one-shot still moving at its last frame.
Retiring an id before the game has stopped asking for it.
judge: npm run check, then look: the SVG, the gallery, the rules page.
npx tsx scripts/inspect.ts <id> — big, at game scale, in black.
npx tsx scripts/readability.ts --app ss [--ground ss.env.pan] — against the floor it stands on.
npx tsx scripts/sheet.ts <id> --anim <clip>, and scripts/filmstrip.ts <id> death — a clip posed the way the adapters pose it.
A human listens before a sound is declared good; the bake's measurements stand in until then.

paint.because: the arsenal is hive material with the signal stripped out
the arsenal is hive material with the signal stripped out
